summary: Frontend-only review of 3 Sendbid items pre-APK build. ITEM 1 (floating verification shield top-right) ✅ visible on home & transfers (top≈32px, right offset≈64px, testID 'floating-verify-shield' present, animated pulse+glow+sparkle confirmed). ITEM 2 (wallet/op timeline 'Mises à jour' aligned on 'Informations' typo+spacing) ✅ verified — tab renders 'Calendrier de transfert', timeline rows show check/circle 16px icons left, caption-style labels left, caption-style date right, bottom-border separator, vertical bar connectors retained. ITEM 3 (transfer row click) ❌ CRITICAL BUG REPRODUCED — every tap on a transfer row crashes the screen with 'TypeError: t is not a function' at app/transfer/[id].tsx:400:26. The hardening (Réessayer screen on 404) DOES work for invalid UUIDs, but it cannot save the success-path render: a local-state variable named `t` shadows the imported i18n `t()` translation function. Detail page never renders for any of the 50 seeded transfers (verified row clicks AND direct URL navigation to 3 valid IDs).

ui_bugs.issue: BLOCKING CRASH: 'TypeError: t is not a function' thrown at line 400 (FinRow label={t('transferFlow.fees')}). Root cause: line 155 `const [t, setT] = useState<any>(null)` shadows the i18n `t` imported at line 2 `import { t, useLocale } from '../../src/i18n'`. After fetch succeeds, `t` is the transfer object — calling `t('transferFlow.fees')` throws and unmounts the screen. Backend GET /api/transfers/{id} returns 200 OK with valid payload — the bug is 100% frontend variable-shadowing. All 50 seeded transfers (cash + bank) are unopenable from the Transferts tab. Fix: rename the state variable (e.g. `const [tx, setTx] = useState(...)` and update all references) OR alias the import (`import { t as tr } from ...`). The fake-UUID retry screen works because the crash happens only on the success render branch.

integration_issues.issue: Each tap navigates correctly but the detail component throws on render before any UI is visible. User sees red error overlay in dev / blank screen in prod. Reference: TransferDetail component stack reported by LogBox.

action_items: URGENT: In /app/frontend/app/transfer/[id].tsx rename the state variable currently called `t` (line 155+ and ~70 usages such as `t.status`, `t.send_amount`, `t.beneficiary`, etc.) to avoid colliding with the imported i18n function `t`. Suggested change: `const [tx, setTx] = useState<any>(null);` then replace all `t.` / `setT(` accordingly. Also update the 4 builder helpers (buildCashStandard, buildCashVip, buildBank, buildMomo) which receive a parameter called `t` — rename it to `tx` to keep the `t()` translation function reachable. Re-test by clicking every visible transfer row.

After fix, confirm `t('transferFlow.fees')` resolves to the translated label and that timeline + FINANCIER + DATES blocks render for both COMPLETED (bank id 6dc2e650) and AGENT_ASSIGNED (cash id 994eb1f1) transfers.
critical_code_review_comments: Variable shadowing of the i18n `t` import by local state in app/transfer/[id].tsx is the single root cause of the user-reported error. Same shadowing pattern exists for all `buildXxx(t)` helpers.
VerificationShieldFloating: clean, properly uses useSafeAreaInsets and react-native-safe-area-context; visible state correctly tied to email_verified/phone_verified. No issue.
wallet/op/[id].tsx: timeline restyle correctly mirrors KV styling (paddingVertical 8, borderBottom #F3F4F6, caption variant on both sides). No issue.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-test ITEM 3 after rename. Login client@sendbid.app / Client@123! / PIN 123456 (note: app auto-locks every ~30s so always handle the 'App verrouillée' / 'Confirmer votre identité' PIN modal between navigations). Then go to /transfers and tap each of the first 3 rows (ids start 6dc2e650 bank-COMPLETED, 994eb1f1 cash-AGENT_ASSIGNED, 63a01051 cash-AGENT_ASSIGNED). rca_of_issue: BUG ITEM 3 — RCA: app/transfer/[id].tsx line 2 imports { t, useLocale } from '../../src/i18n' (i18n translator). Line 155 declares useState<any>(null) destructured as `[t, setT]` — shadowing the import inside the component body. Line 400 inside the success-render branch calls `t('transferFlow.fees')`. Since `t` is now the transfer object received from /api/transfers/{id}, calling it as a function throws 'TypeError: t is not a function'. React unmounts the component (error boundary). User perceives this as the 'message d'erreur en cliquant sur une ligne de transfert'. Reproduction: login → Transferts → tap any row. Mitigation: rename state variable to `tx` (and adjust the 4 buildXxx helpers + ~70 references). The previously applied hardening (Number(item.send_amount||0) in list & retry screen on fetch error) is good but does not address the success-path crash.
